name: emw-subset-classes
label: EMwrap Subset Classes
help: Keep the particles of the selected 3D classes from a 3D classification job. Inspect the classes of the 3D classification, then list the class numbers to keep. The particles are selected by their 'rlnClassNumber' value.

params.name: input_set
params.label: Select classes from:
params.help: Particles STAR file of the 3D classification iteration (e.g. Class3D/job017/run_it025_data.star), or an optimisation_set.star (e.g. Class3D/job017/run_it025_optimisation_set.star). With particles as input, only the filtered particles.star is generated. With an optimisation set, its particles are filtered and a new optimisation_set.star pointing to them is also generated.

params.name: classes
params.label: Classes to keep:
params.help: Class numbers to keep, separated by commas or spaces. Ranges are allowed, e.g. '1,3-4' keeps classes 1, 3 and 4. The output is particles.star with the particles of these classes.
